note: Every look on record labelled lost-duel, 23: the 18 the 13 Oct 2026 forensics bench gave on the repo's own Abyss 13 to 11, verbatim (all of round 3, the death the models on record disagree on most), and the 5 of the player's library (the Abyss swiftplay's round 2, the Fracture swiftplay's 5 and 6, the Pearl swiftplay's 1 and 5), retyped as equivalents, each better play tripping the same phrase lists it did. test:forensics holds that the phrase lists never change a label on any of them.

answers.what: You were firing at an enemy from Mid Library, and Cypher killed you with a Spectre.
answers.better: You had cover nearby, so fall back behind it rather than staying in the duel.

answers.what: You fought an enemy from Mid Library and later died to Cypher, with no trade within five seconds.
answers.better: You could use cloudburst to break sight and fall back instead of staying in the fight.

answers.what: You were firing at an enemy from cover in Mid Library, and Cypher killed you with a Spectre shortly afterward.
answers.better: Stay near cover and disengage if you cannot win the exchange.

answers.what: You were in Mid Library at full health, firing your rifle down a long corridor at an enemy, and Cypher beat you in that fight with his Spectre, even though you got 40 damage on him.
answers.better: Take the same fight from a spot where a teammate can see the same lane, or pause your spray and reset behind cover once the Spectre starts hitting you, so one lost exchange does not end your round.

answers.what: You were in Mid Library at full health and armor, already firing down the corridor at an enemy, and Cypher's Spectre won that exchange two seconds later.
answers.better: Against a Spectre at that range, fire short controlled bursts at the head and step back behind the wall to reset the fight, so a teammate can help instead of you trading shots alone.

answers.what: You were at full health in Mid Library, holding the corridor with a rifle and shooting at an enemy down the hall, and Cypher's Spectre won the exchange before a teammate could trade.
answers.better: Take the same fight from a half step back behind the corner, so a teammate has a line to trade you, and stop firing to reposition if the first shots miss.

answers.what: You were at full health in Mid Library with a Vandal, already firing at an enemy down the corridor, and you lost that gunfight to the Cypher's Spectre.
answers.better: Take the same fight a step back behind the corner so a teammate can see the angle and trade you, and win it with first-bullet accuracy or a tap instead of spraying in the open.

answers.what: You were at Mid Library with full health, firing your Vandal at an enemy down the long hallway, and you lost that fight to the Cypher's Spectre while teammates were close on the minimap.
answers.better: Take that duel from a spot where you can strafe and stop before shooting, so the Spectre cannot win the exchange, and stay tight with your teammates so a trade is there if you lose.

answers.what: You were at full health in Mid Library with a Vandal, trading shots with an enemy at the far end of the corridor, and Cypher's Spectre won the exchange.
answers.better: Take the duel from a tighter angle, or step back behind cover after your first burst so you do not stand in a long straight line against his spray.

answers.what: You were at full health in Mid Library with a Vandal, shooting at an enemy down the long corridor, and you lost the fight to the Cypher's Spectre while your team held the numbers advantage.
answers.better: Hold the corridor from behind cover and take the shot only when a teammate can swing with you, so a lost shot can be traded.

answers.what: You were at Mid Library with full health, holding a Vandal and already shooting at an enemy down the hallway, with teammates close by on the minimap, and you lost that gunfight to the Cypher's Spectre.
answers.better: Fire a short controlled burst, then step back behind the wall so a teammate can swing with you, instead of standing in the open trading shots down the hallway.

answers.what: You were in Mid Library at full health, firing your Vandal down the hallway at an enemy, and you lost that gunfight to the Cypher's Spectre while teammates were still alive on the minimap.
answers.better: Keep taking this fight from cover and stop firing in the open, so you can pull back behind the wall after the first shots and make the Spectre come to you.

answers.what: You were in Mid Library at full health and already firing your Vandal down the hallway at an enemy, with teammates close on the minimap, and the Cypher with a Spectre won the exchange.
answers.better: Take that fight from a spot where a teammate can see the same enemy, or stop and reset your aim after the first shots so the trade is there if you lose the duel.

answers.what: You were firing a Vandal in the open at a distant enemy on Mid Library while your team was holding elsewhere, and the fight ended with the killer's Spectre fire.
answers.better: Hold back behind cover near your teammates and wait for a trade partner or utility before taking a shot at the enemy.

answers.what: You were firing a Vandal down the Mid Library corridor at an enemy in the open while a teammate lay dead nearby, with no clear sign of a bad position or an unlit angle in this frame.
answers.better: Hold back until a teammate is near or you have information on the angle, so the duel is not taken alone.

answers.what: You were firing a Vandal down a corridor at an enemy in the open, with a teammate lying downed nearby and the enemy's fire on you, and the duel went against you.
answers.better: Hold the angle with a teammate close enough to trade, or wait for utility before committing to the peek.

answers.what: You fought an enemy from cover in Mid Library and died to Cypher with a Spectre.
answers.better: You could have stayed behind cover and taken the next fight alongside a teammate.

answers.what: You were in Mid Library at full health, firing your Vandal down the corridor at an enemy in a straight fight, and the Cypher with the Spectre won it before you finished him.
answers.better: Take that fight from a spot with a bit of cover, tap or burst at that range instead of spraying, and be ready to step back behind the corner if your first shots miss.

answers.what: You played B Main from cover and lost the gunfight to Tejo’s Outlaw.
answers.better: After your last shots, fall back behind cover to reload so Tejo does not get another shot.

answers.what: You held an angle from cover on A Site, shot at the Jett you could see, and lost the duel to her Sheriff.
answers.better: Keep the wall as cover, but fall back after your first shots instead of staying on that angle.

answers.what: You fought Chamber from B Tree with your Sheriff, fired three times, and died without doing damage.
answers.better: Take your next shot from cover instead of staying exposed in that duel.

answers.what: On B Site, you shot at Clove from beside cover and lost the pistol duel without hurting them.
answers.better: Stay next to cover and aim before you fire so you can retreat if your first shots miss.

answers.what: You pulled out your Ghost and fought Cypher up close in Mid Plaza, doing 105 damage before his Classic killed you.
answers.better: Have your Ghost out as you reach the doorway so you take the fight without switching weapons under fire.
